ruling: Tim, 2026-09-17 14:25Z: "I don't think you need to recheck the held-out set every time we add news articles". This file is what that ruling means in numbers. It is a POLICY path: it changes only by a PR Tim merges (memory: legislative-prs), and nothing in a run may soften it (verification-doctrine 12).

routine_pack.what: A news-lane content pack, small enough and of a family routine enough that the daily gate may stand in for the 1,418-query battery. Anything outside these bounds -- a larger pack, a family the news lane did not onboard, a ranking or config change, a rebuild -- takes the full ADR-043 gate with the am.3 null arm.
routine_pack.why_these_bounds: The largest daily pack this lane has sealed is 14,819 rows against 33,723,480 points = 0.044% (task 598/600/604). 20,000 rows leaves the lane headroom for a catch-up day without letting a rebuild-sized write through; 0.1% keeps the bound proportional as the collection grows, so the absolute number cannot quietly become a large fraction of a smaller index.

slice.what: The queries the daily gate scores: the WHOLE gold core (authoritative + foundation + legal + names -- 639 golds since ADR-107 am.3 removed 24 contaminated queries), the flood set and the three acceptance probes: 667 of the battery's 1,418, under the same ids, with the same golds. Generated by cytir/gates/news_daily_slice.py (`aw gate news-daily-slice`); regenerating it is a PR, and a gold set whose sha256 moved refuses the run rather than being scored against a stale roster.
slice.measured_sensitivity: On the 09-16 pack (task 604 sec.5, the three sealed arms projected at ) this gate reads h@1 206->201 (-5) and h@10 350->349 (-1) -- the same deltas the 663-gold battery read on those arms -- with a quiet null arm (0 golds moved), 18 losses, tripwires clean and flood unchanged. It refuses the pack the battery refused.

conditions.tripwires: legal + names, per-gold zero-loss, computed on the RAW ranks -- never corrected, never waived. ADR-043 am.6: a tripwire loss must also be ATTRIBUTABLE before it refuses. A tripwire gold that an am.3 null arm also moved, with no content difference, is the instrument's and is reported as such; one the null arm left alone refuses at ONE, as before; and a tripwire loss with NO null arm is UNADJUDICATED and still refuses. The null arm must be this run's (its basis names the baseline arm it adjudicates) and must itself be a CONVERGED reading under am.5. A5's own converged pair is not an admissible basis: it agrees per gold on this population by construction, so it can attribute nothing.
conditions.probes: The three acceptance probes may not regress (the same probe_non_regression contract the battery applies).
conditions.flood: ADR-043 condition 2 on rel_vs_trust: h@1 and h@10 non-increasing.
conditions.net: ADR-043 condition 1 over its own population: h@1 and h@10 net-non-negative across the gold core, or within the band an ADR-043 am.3 null arm measures if one is supplied.
conditions.not_judged_here: The other 755 held-out queries -- slice_b, the dom_* sets, jurisdiction, freshness, commercial, general_flood, entity cards, zero_signal, vocab robustness -- and am.3's null arm. Those are the weekly battery's, which is exactly what Tim's ruling moved off the daily path.
conditions.no_class_broken: ADR-043 condition 3: no gold class may fall below half its h@10. Computable daily only because the whole core is scored.

cadence.why_not_in_the_repo: The ledger is runtime state, and the release tree it would sit in is hash-closed -- a file written into it aborts the next news tick's closure preflight (task 501 sec.6, the __pycache__ incident). The contract lives here; the counter lives in the lane's state dir.
cadence.fail_closed: A missing, unreadable or battery-less ledger REFUSES the routine path. A counter that cannot be read is not a counter that reads zero (verification-doctrine 6).
cadence.release_binding: A routine pack whose release git_sha differs from the last passing battery's takes a battery first: two arms cut under different releases are not comparable, so the accumulated drift since the last battery would be unmeasurable.
cadence.battery_protocol: The due pack is applied under --gate-profile content-pack: the 1,418-query pre/post pair and ADR-043 am.3's arithmetic judge that day. The accumulated drift since the last battery is measured on the slice, by judging that day's pre-apply slice arm against the slice arm sealed at the previous battery. The same week-over-week comparison on the full 663 is not available today (compare_corpus_arms.py refuses two arms of one representation) -- a named limit, not a waiver.
cadence.on_pass: python -m cytir.gates.news_daily record --event battery, citing the arm and the verdict; the counter restarts from that row.

on_refusal.daily: The ADR-098 transaction aborts before the production write, exactly as today, and the twin is rolled back. The lane returns to handoff-only and the orchestrator escalates to Tim with the number. The daily gate never adjudicates its own refusal and never waives (memory: gate-waivers-escalate-to-tim).
on_refusal.weekly: A weekly battery below the band FREEZES the news lane -- handoff-only, no routine applies -- and escalates to Tim with the measured net. The freeze is what bounds the accumulated drift to one battery interval.
